page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7.32xlarge is a general-purpose instance type built on the KVM hypervisor. It features 128 dedicated physical cores and 128 vCPUs powered by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor operating at a base frequency of 2.7 GHz. The x86_64 architecture operates with a 1.0 thread-per-core configuration, ensuring dedicated compute resources without hyperthreading.

The instance is equipped with 512.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced ratio of 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or integrated GPUs, requiring reliance on external block storage for data persistence. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 64 Gbps.

This instance offers high resource density for workloads requiring significant parallel processing capabilities and substantial memory capacity. The dedicated core allocation provides predictable compute performance, making it appropriate for enterprise applications, large-scale web serving, database hosting, and distributed build systems that do not require local NVMe storage or GPU acceleration.
